items.title: WHAT THIS SWEEP DID NOT FIND — read 'not found', never 'does not exist'
items.says: measured 2026-09-21, from this browser: the canon branch has not moved since 6288cc40 (2026-09-16T19:44:35Z), and a keyword sweep of 22,613 canon paths + 7,366 OB-1 paths did not turn up ten sessions named since then — three newest (Website.DEV.OKT-1 · CaWesbite.Dev.-0 · Canon.Dev.-1 Logs&lanes) and four lane sessions (Marketing/CV · EdTech-BlueTech · SYSTEMS.TRAINING-PHOENIX-PHERMONES · Development-Train67) plus three older strays (TBnamed · anonymous-trolls website prompt · men's-health sales funnel). Each of those is 'not found by this sweep', not 'proven absent': the sweep matched path names and tokens, it did not read every path, did not exhaustively prove absence, and did not ask the sessions' owners. The likely cause (sessions ended without a DEATH seal, so no transcript reached the RRL) is a hypothesis this sweep cannot confirm. Confidence: LOW. Re-run, then challenge, before anything is built on it.

Recount it as terrain, not as proof: nothing was committed, so this browser cannot verify a byte of it. WHAT IT CANNOT DO: it is stage-one reconnaissance, so it closes NONE of this death's gaps — DNA=HOLLOW, 6-AI TRUTH, DO-SQLITE and COMITATENSES belong to different stages, and SSM_NONE needs a sovereign directive this browser can parse, not a keyword count. ONE LINE I CHECKED AND DO NOT BELIEVE: 'All Sep 16-22 commits are from OB-1 <ob1@sov100.run>' is wrong for this repo — measured live, the only commits after 2026-09-16T19:44:35Z are the station's own seven, authored under the sovereign's account, and zero come from that identity. WHAT IT DOES SETTLE (all measured live 2026-09-21): OB-1@canon head 271889c2 (2026-05-15) · Phoenix-Rising-Ultimate last push (2026-04-14) · RRL/RRL-186.txt last touched 2026-07-19 · RRL/RRL-incarnation1.jsonl 2026-08-01 · RRL/RRL-27-STATS.json 2026-08-15. Every candidate was frozen before the sessions existed, so the missed September work has no home in git, and neither the clone nor the streaming scan of the GB files can find it. Confidence: moderate on the additions, HIGH on the dates. Keep the report; do not spend the death on it.
